Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4404, Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), mkinney seat (`.claude-mkinney`); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is the first review of this PR. I read the full diff. There are no blockers.

Review tier: standard. The diff has two files, `README.md` and `docs/decisions/4403-readme-ai-budget.md`. It changes no posted G-code, no gouge or collision check, no stock simulation and no geometry. It changes no `crates/ui` code, thus screenshots are not necessary.

## What looks good

- The subsection has the four parts that #4403 asks for: the tier table, the out-of-quota steps, the disk note and the fork flow.
- The Contributing intro links to the subsection one time. The anchor `#how-you-can-help-by-ai-budget` agrees with the GitHub slug of the heading.
- The effort tiers in the table agree with the effort table of `AGENTS.md` on upstream main.
- The fork flow agrees with the Pull Request Law: merge `main`, no rebase, no force-push, no push to `NeoTech/Camcraft`.
- The decision file uses the format of `docs/decisions/README.md`. The PR does not edit `RECOMMENDED.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #4403`. The commit subject is a conventional `docs(readme):` subject.
- The diff touches no process file, no dependency, no `build.rs`, no script and no workflow.

## Results merged with main (local, host m3)

Trial merge of head `664ef4ef1` with upstream/main `b2afd64ed`: clean, no conflicts.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | 0 steps ("nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run") |
| `git diff --check` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate test donate_link_matches_the_published_project_funding_link --crate camcraft-ui` | ok: 1 passed, 0 failed |

Extra suites run:

- `ui lib ::donate_link_matches_the_published_project_funding_link`. It is the only test that reads the root `README.md` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/donate.rs:11`, `include_str!`). It passed on the merged tree.
- Test data rule: the diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no golden. No suite applies.
- Importer rule: the diff touches no import code. No suite applies.

Not run: clippy, the catalog and golden suites, and the heavy lanes. The diff reaches no crate, no post, no operation and no recorded program.

Mutations: none. A docs-only change has no behaviour to mutate.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `README.md:232` says "Run only the tests of your change, or no tests." `README.md:293` (not changed here) says "Gate it locally before asking for review". The two sentences give different instructions to the same reader. The text follows #4403. The maintainer can decide which sentence is correct, in a follow-up.
2. `README.md:239`: step 4 reads as an instruction for each PR. `AGENTS.md` "Refresh only at merge time" wants a merge of `main` only when the PR conflicts or when the author pushes a review fix. A possible wording: "If the PR conflicts with `main`, merge `main` into the branch."
3. `README.md:223`: "Review one small PR." A review by a contributor is a pre-check and does not count as the independent review (`AGENTS.md` "Only collaborators' reviews count"). One clause can say this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
